description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on B' Onions
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing a levy on specific commodities. It constitutes a regulatory instrument that modifies or implements existing legislation, specifically dealing with tax regulations and compliance requirements. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
